name: Prometheus
summary: Push Ogun metrics to a Prometheus Pushgateway in the Prometheus text format, for a Prometheus server to scrape.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

settings.name: port
settings.label: Port
settings.help: 9091 is the Pushgateway default; 443 behind a TLS proxy.

settings.name: job
settings.label: Job name
settings.help: The job in the push path, /metrics/job/NAME.

notes: Metrics: ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances by state; names are written with underscores. Prometheus has no event type, so failed runs and approvals waiting for a person are not sent here.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
